text.p: These are the headlines from selected Canadian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Chretien sees perils in minority: Strong majority needed to ensure zero deficit and other promises met, Liberal Leader says.
- And the West may be history.
- Jones case returns to haunt Clinton: Supreme Court gives woman dismissed as 'trailer-park trash' a new hand to play.
- Parizeau: Pick PM outside Quebec: Separatist agrees with Manning.
- Spaceballs vindicate Chicken Little scientist: House-size, snowy, cometary objects are raining on Earth's atmosphere, satellite data and images show.
- Seagram cuts Time Warner stake: Sells more than half its 11.2 percent interest in rival entertainment giant for C$1.4 billion.
- Investment trusts fuel boom in IPOs: How markets keep prices attractive.
- Windsor plant could suffer in Chrysler minivan plans: Observers say Mexican, U.S. plants may get most of action.
- Summer looks bleak for tourism industry: Sun-deprived Canadians heading south.
- Ault courts Italian savior: As the Toronto dairy company battles a C$320-million hostile bid from Quebec's Saputo Group, giant Parmalat looms large among prospective white knights.
- Rigel discovers huge oilfield in the North Sea.
